Game Overview

At its heart, Tiger Run is a animal game about race through the vibrant jungle as a swift tiger, deftly dodging obstacles and gathering coins. Experience the thrill of non-stop survival with intuitive controls for jumping and lane-switching. Immerse yourself in ever-changing scenery and strategic power-ups that keep each adventure fresh and exhilarating.

Playing Tiger Run comes down to a simple loop. Race through the vibrant jungle as a swift tiger, deftly dodging obstacles and gathering coins.
